question.problem: A publisher has noticed that the minimum time needed to review a book is $115$ working days, and the maximum time is $235$ days. Assuming that the review time is uniformly distributed, what is the variance of the time needed to review a book?
question.worked_solution:
Let $X$ represent the time needed to review a randomly chosen book. From the problem statement, we know that $X∼U[115,235],$ and we wish to compute $\text{Var}[X].$

In general, if $X∼U[a,b],$ then $X$ has the following variance:

$$
\text{Var}[X]=\frac{(b-a)^{2}}{12}
$$

So, for our random variable $X∼U[115,235],$ we have the following variance:

$$
\text{Var}[X]=\frac{(235-115)^{2}}{12}=\frac{14400}{12}=1200
$$

Therefore, the variance of the reviewing time is $1200\,{\text{days}}^{2}.$
